GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is chosen when the authenticated member requests information about their current or past loans using their server-validated session token.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If the query is about viewing the member's own loans, use LibraryAgentMyLoansAction.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only provide details about the authenticated member's current and past loans using the server-validated session token. You cannot disclose loan information for other members or perform any write operations.
